The '''Torina system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torina]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Torine]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
